blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings featuring five rotating tastes, elevated tasting experiences, and wine by the glass or bottle at the Old Redhook Brewery location. Premium experiences include winery tours and food pairings, and a sensory Black Glass Challenge. The tasting room offers indoor and patio seating, with private event spaces available.
